	desc = antq_m11_flavor.6196.desc
	outcome = neutral
	fire_only_once = yes
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event/antq_alemanni_formation.dds"
	dynamic_historical_event = {
		tag = XBL
		from = 213.3.15
		to = 213.5.16
		monthly_chance = 100
	}
	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = antq_m11_alemanni_formation_directed_path } NOT = { has_variable = antq_m11_alemanni_formation_delegated_path } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_variable = antq_m10_alemanni_formation_chronicle_path
						has_variable = antq_m10_alemanni_formation_command_path
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = antq_m11_alemanni_formation_directed_path value = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = antq_m10_alemanni_formation_compact_path }
				set_variable = { name = antq_m11_alemanni_formation_delegated_path value = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = antq_m11_alemanni_formation_directed_path } }
			set_variable = { name = antq_m11_alemanni_formation_directed_path value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = antq_m11_alemanni_formation_delegated_path } }
			set_variable = { name = antq_m11_alemanni_formation_delegated_path value = 0 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m11_flavor.6196.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 58
			modifier = { factor = 0.3 gold < 16 }
			modifier = { factor = 1.25 stability < 0 }
		}
		add_gold = -8
		add_research_progress = research_progress_weak_bonus
		add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = antq_m11_alemanni_formation_directed_path } }
			set_variable = { name = antq_m11_alemanni_formation_directed_path value = 0 }
		}
		change_variable = { name = antq_m11_alemanni_formation_directed_path add = 1 }
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m11_flavor.6196.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 42
			modifier = { factor = 1.7 gold < 16 }
			modifier = { factor = 1.2 at_war = yes }
		}
		add_gold = -4
		add_legitimacy = legitimacy_weak_bonus
		add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
		if = {
